# Andrew Ho

Andrew Ho's personal site covering applied AI, systems, software, readings, and principles for making decisions.

Canonical site: https://www.anmho.com

## Machine-readable discovery

- [Full public content](https://www.anmho.com/llms-full.txt): plain text export of the public site content.
- [Sitemap](https://www.anmho.com/sitemap.xml): every public section, article, and note URL.
- [Robots policy](https://www.anmho.com/robots.txt): public crawl policy.

## Start here

- [Home](https://www.anmho.com/): current introduction and links to the rest of the site.
- [About](https://www.anmho.com/about): contact and profile links.
- [Goals](https://www.anmho.com/goals): reflect on a goal through the public Tenets and read the changelog of changing priorities.
- [Tenets](https://www.anmho.com/tenets): public principles and their sources.
- [Articles](https://www.anmho.com/articles): long-form technical writing.
- [Notes](https://www.anmho.com/notes): shorter technical notes.
- [Learnings](https://www.anmho.com/learnings): searchable engineering questions, answers, and examples.
- [Readings](https://www.anmho.com/readings): books and other readings.
- [Watch](https://www.anmho.com/watch): talks and videos.
- [Bookmarks](https://www.anmho.com/resources): curated external resources.
- [Projects](https://www.anmho.com/projects): selected projects and technical work.

## Machine-readable interfaces

- `GET https://www.anmho.com/api/tenets`: list the public Tenets available to decision tools.
- `GET https://www.anmho.com/api/goals`: inspect the Goals API contract, public changelog, and age privacy behavior.
- `POST https://www.anmho.com/api/goals`: submit `{ "goal": "...", "context": "..." }` for a structured reflection.
- `GET https://www.anmho.com/api/perspective`: inspect the personal perspective endpoint.
- `POST https://www.anmho.com/api/perspective`: submit `{ "question": "...", "context": "..." }` for a first-person answer grounded in public Tenets, writings, readings, projects, and saved resources.
- `GET https://www.anmho.com/api/openapi`: retrieve the OpenAPI 3.1 description.

Private Tenets are never included in the public APIs or public Goals and Perspective model prompts. The admin-only Decisions API includes them by design. These tools are reflection aids, not professional advice or autonomous decision-makers.
